node.statement: Explicit validated-premise threshold step: require nodes 1.1 and 1.2 to be validated. Enlarge their universal constants harmlessly so that C_0>=1 and M_0>=1, and set e_close=min{e_R,e_0,1/[2 C_0(2M_0+1)]}>0. For an EXT-CB datum with e<=e_close, node 1.2 gives bounded idempotents E=Co_{R,Q}, F=Co_{P,Q}, with R=v(I_r), ||E||<=M_0 and ||E-F||<=C_0 e. Therefore ||E-F||(2||E||+1)<=C_0 e_close(2M_0+1)<=1/2<1.
